last_scan_method: Free TinyFish Search and Fetch + direct public artist/release pages; human-directed track search, NOT live Google metrics

search_sample.engine: TinyFish Search public web, not Google Search Console

scan_policy.trigger: Whenever a human-directed new-track scan is actually completed
scan_policy.action: Refresh public source evidence and date, update add-on dataset and inline snapshot, build original source tests, read back deployment. A scan date is not a background scheduler.
scan_policy.search_term_samples_update: On each explicitly performed new track research, refresh zero-price public search sampling and link counts in the source JSON before the staged build. No paid background monitoring.

evidence_note: Public artist and song pages show availability and catalogued discovery URLs. Counts are NOT Google index counts, unique viewers, ranking, traffic, total platform inventory or Search Console analytics.

discovery_index.calculation: Grounded heuristic: 60 points for directly read original profile/release, 54 for readable public profile, 42 for search-index artist link only; plus min(35, round(12 * log10(catalogued_urls + 1))) where this exact provider has inventory. No extrapolation for uncatalogued pages. A platform without a count gets base points only.
discovery_index.refresh: Only when an actual verified new-track scan explicitly updates evidence and current catalog data; never by page load or background billing.
discovery_index.sort: descending indexed evidence, tie alphabetical; NO visitor/ranking/search position implication.

search_term_samples.source: TinyFish Search exact quoted phrase query; NOT Google index/API/Search Console
search_term_samples.count_mode: distinct returned result URLs across three pages; non-exhaustive query sample

terms.source_note: Exact English artist spelling found on publicly indexed music credits, Qobuz, YouTube and Facebook; 3 pages free TinyFish Search 2026-11-05.
